1. System overview

VDARVS digitizes village administration in Lesotho: citizen registration, residency verification, official documents, disputes, animal and land records, and staff access control.

Each user signs in with email and password. The sidebar shows only pages their role can access. Approvals for residency, documents, disputes, animals, and land are performed by the village chief, not the administrator.

2. User roles and demo accounts

RoleEmailMain responsibilities
Citizencitizen@example.lsOnboarding, document requests, file disputes
Village chiefchief.masianokeng@vdarvs.gov.lsVerify residency, approve documents, resolve disputes, approve animals/land
Village staffstaff.masianokeng@vdarvs.gov.lsRegister citizens, animals, and land
District officerdistrict.maseru@vdarvs.gov.lsReports, audit logs, backup residency verification
Administratoradmin@vdarvs.gov.lsApprove role access requests only
The administrator does not verify citizenship or approve documents. Use the village chief account for those tasks.

3. Getting started

3.1 Sign in

  1. Open https://vdarvs-ebon.vercel.app/login.
  2. Enter email and password Vdarvs2026!.
  3. Click Sign in. You are redirected to the dashboard.

3.2 New citizen signup

  1. From the landing page, click Sign up.
  2. Create an account (default role: citizen).
  3. Complete Onboarding to register in your village.

4. Core workflow (citizen to chief)

1. Citizen → Onboarding → Submit citizen application 2. Village chief → Residency Verification → Verify 3. Citizen → Documents → Request document 4. Village chief → Documents → Approve 5. Citizen → Notifications → sees approval

Step 1: Citizen application

  1. Sign in as citizen@example.ls.
  2. Go to Onboarding → Apply as citizen.
  3. Fill the form (Masianokeng / Maseru defaults work).
  4. Click Submit citizen application.

Step 2: Chief verifies residency

  1. Sign in as chief.masianokeng@vdarvs.gov.ls.
  2. Open Residency Verification.
  3. Click Verify on the pending citizen.
  4. Citizen receives a notification.

Steps 3 and 4: Document requests

Citizen requests

  1. Citizen → Documents → Request document.
  2. Choose type, enter title, submit.

Chief approves

  1. Chief → Documents → Approve or Reject.

5. Citizen features

  • Dashboard — residency status, counts, workflow guide.
  • Documents — request and track certificates.
  • Disputes — file cases for chief mediation.
  • Notifications — updates on your requests.

6. Village chief features

  • Residency Verification — verify new citizens.
  • Documents — approve or reject requests.
  • Disputes — Resolve or Dismiss.
  • Animals / Land — approve staff registrations.

7. Village staff features

  1. Citizens → Register citizen — sends record to chief queue.
  2. Animals → Register animal — chief approves.
  3. Land → Register land — chief approves.

8. District officer features

  • Reports — district statistics.
  • Audit Logs — system action history.

9. Administrator features

  1. Review Role Requests when users request staff access.
  2. Approve or reject. User role updates in the database.
  3. Staff Accounts is read-only.

10. Notifications and audit trail

Approvals create citizen notifications and audit log entries. Chiefs get notified on new applications, documents, and disputes. Administrators get notified on role requests.

Automated test: pnpm test:e2e. See docs/demo-flow.md.
